message.content: {"note_claim": "A helicopter must tilt its rotor disk to move forward, so a video showing forward motion without tilting violates aerodynamic physics.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The faster the helicopter flies, the more drag (red arrow) it will incur, and the more the pilot must tilt the main rotor thrust forward.", "reason": "The page directly explains that forward helicopter flight requires tilting the main rotor thrust forward to counter drag, substantiating the note's claim about the physics principle being violated."}

parsed.note_claim: A helicopter must tilt its rotor disk to move forward, so a video showing forward motion without tilting violates aerodynamic physics.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The faster the helicopter flies, the more drag (red arrow) it will incur, and the more the pilot must tilt the main rotor thrust forward.
parsed.reason: The page directly explains that forward helicopter flight requires tilting the main rotor thrust forward to counter drag, substantiating the note's claim about the physics principle being violated.
